query:
SELECT 
  tm.id as staff_id,
  tm.name as staff_name,
  tm.email as staff_email,
  tm.role as staff_role,
  tm.organizationId,
  tm.isActive,
  o.name as organization_name
FROM team_members tm
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON tm.organizationId = o.id
ORDER BY o.name, tm.name;
